description: This file defines models and functions for CRM profiling and segmentation in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including questions, answers, questionnaires, and segmentation rules.

classes.name: question
classes.description: Model representing a profiling question with possible answers.

classes.name: questionnaire
classes.description: Model representing a questionnaire composed of questions.

classes.name: answer
classes.description: Model representing an answer to a question.

classes.name: partner
classes.description: Extension of res.partner with profiling answers and categorization logic.

classes.name: crm_segmentation
classes.description: Extension of crm.segmentation with profiling answer filters and hierarchical profiles.

methods.name: _get_answers
methods.description: Retrieves distinct 'yes' and 'no' answers associated with given profile IDs.

methods.name: _get_parents
methods.description: Recursively retrieves parent profile IDs for given segmentation IDs.

methods.name: test_prof
methods.description: Tests if a partner matches a segmentation rule based on answers.

methods.name: _recompute_categ
methods.description: Recomputes partner categories based on answers and segmentation rules.

methods.name: build_form
methods.description: Builds an XML form for a questionnaire.

methods.name: _questionnaire_compute
methods.description: Computes and updates partner answers and categories based on questionnaire responses.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method to update partner categories based on answers.

methods.name: process_continue
methods.description: Processes segmentation profiles, applying rules and updating partner categories.
